title: Những tấm ảnh phai
about: Round 40, hoc-vien ("8 BẢN DARK PIANO NHẸ NHÀNG ĐỂ NGHE TRƯỚC KHI NGỦ"), the Dark Academia set, Faded Photographs: looking again at photographs gone pale, B minor at 55 bpm: a mellow upright as if heard from an old tape, very lightly (its top rounded off, a little warmth in the middle, its pitch drifting 3 cents, too little to hear as an effect; no hiss, no crackle); a plain tune (D-C#-B, dotted) over chords broken slowly upward in quarters (texture slowarp, from D3); the tune returns over other chords; the middle in D major. Written to the brief's rules: the piano leads in the middle, now and then the upper middle, never low or heavy (the left hand from D3, no octave under it, the last chord rolled from the middle); a short tune of few notes with rests; struck softly and evenly; minor harmony moving slowly; no climax, no fast notes, no speeding up; every return changed a little (its last note, a rest, the left hand). An original tune.
